::: {.lead-note}

I have been a teaching assistant in the Department of Economics, Faculty of
Economics and Business, Universitas Indonesia since February 2024, working
almost entirely on the econometrics sequence across the master's and doctoral
programmes. Separately, I am a permanent public procurement instructor for the
Government of North Sulawesi and a nationally certified facilitator and
competency assessor.

:::
